title: Profinet: Update several enum according to PN AL Protocol, Oct20
description:
Indices, user structure identifier, channel error type, ext channel error types

Decode more known indexes, the only one where this has an effect is PDPortDataRealExtended, the other indexes won't be decoded because contained the blocks are not implemented.
